Black Friday for Riders: Take a Look at a Few Brands With Massive Sales on Their Phone Mounts
20 photos
Photo: Quad Lock
Imagine riding down the highway on a motorcycle, suddenly receiving a phone call, and having to dig it out of your pocket in order to answer. Not only is this a difficult endeavor if you’re wearing jeans, or any pants, for that matter, but it’s downright dangerous, forcing us to take our eyes off the road, even for a split second; it’s all it takes to be the victim of an accident.
So, over the years, there have been countless brands that sought to solve this very issue, among others, developing countless mounting systems to secure your phone within sight and granting us the ability to keep an eye on our calls, messages, Google Maps, Waze, and countless other uses we have for our modern pocket-sized computers.
Well, with Black Friday underway for countless brands all over the world, I’ve decided to bring to light a few brands that build some of the world’s most trusted motorcycle phone mounts and have ongoing Black Friday sales on their goodies.
Quad Lock Quad Lock is one of those teams that really needs no introduction, having been around since 2011 and climbing to international recognition across a wide range of disciplines, be it motorcycles, dirt bikes, or even just good old cycling.
Photo: Quad Lock I decided to place them in the spotlight first as I recently had an encounter with the brand at EICMA where we also took an interview with brand ambassador Charley Boorman, the one and the same that stars in the Long Way Round series with Ewan McGregor.
It was at EICMA that Quad Lock also launched their all-new Pro Adjustable mount, a piece of gear which I personally saw in action and which allows riders to place their phone in whatever position they like, and it stays that way. All you need is a hex key to make the adjustments and lock the whole thing in place.
This brand currently offers 30% of their entire lineup of gear, including chargers, dampers, and even the anti theft screw kit; ALL OF IT! The new Adjustable mount is priced differently all over the world, but in the US, it’s $63 and fits with the existing phones cases in the Quad Lock lineup.
This brand has been and is responsible for some of the most dependable handlebar mounts around, one that have resisted accident after accident and spill. Riders, Boorman included, proclaim that after an accident, the mounts and their phone were fine, even though they weren’t.
Ram Mounts Up next on our list of brands with hot prices on their gear is none other than Ram Mounts, the one and the same that is often spotted battling it out with Quad Lock as the best around. The thing is that, for Black Friday, this brand doesn’t appear to be tampering with prices all over the world, only in some regions. You’ll need to check with local distributors to unlocks prices of up to 20% on their gear.
Photo: Ram Mounts Their X-Grip Universal phone holder is a product that can be acquired for around $40 and since you’ll also need an actual mount, the Tough Ball, Claw (depending on mounting system chosen), and/or others, be sure to weigh your options and look for the best deal around at this time.
Peak Design Another team that people have talked about, including out very own Mircea Mazuru , is Peak Design, a brand that offers a wide range of mounts and cases for countless applications, and ones that work with magnets and a click-in system, depending on the mount, of course.
Photo: Peak Design Here too, the amount of cash you’ll be saving on the Black Friday deals will matter on where you are in the world, but as an idea of what to expect, we can see reductions on items of as much as 35%, sometimes more, depending on what product you’re interested in.
I’m currently stationed over in Europe, and out here, the SlimLink Motorcycle Mirror Mount is going for just €114, down from €190, and including a built-in charging option for your phone.
Rokform Rokform is a team that, according to their Facebook page, has over 198K followers, so clearly, we can’t leave this brand out of the mix here. They offer a similar mounting system to Quad Lock with a four-point, rotate and lock action that does require a special phone case to work, just like most brands out there.
For Black Friday, this team is offering price reductions that may not be as large as those we see for Quad Lock and Peak Design, but they are still there and Rokform is considered a brand with dependable products.
Photo: Rockform As an idea of what we can save with Rokform, their handlebar phone mount with vibration dampener kit is going for $130 instead of $150. The ball phone mount is $175 instead of $200. Phone cases, however, don’t appear to be seeing any price reductions, at least, not for use riders.
SP Connect Last on our list but not least is SP Connect, a brand whose gear I’ve tested on a bicycle. However, they also make mounts for motorcycles, and one that riders do enjoy. This brand is currently offering a 30% reduction on all their gear too, so very Quad Lock-like.
Photo: SP Connect This brand’s Moto Mount 3D is currently up for grabs at $90, but with the promo code, comes down to close to $70, and the Stem Mount Pro is set for $75 and down to $50 with the code. Don’t forget about cases too, selling for a pre-code price of as low as $45.
This brand also requires that you buy a special case, so be sure to choose the right setup for you.
All in All While these are clearly not the only mounting brands the motorcycle rider can call upon, they are some of the most appreciated and worthy of being on your radar, especially in this time of price reductions.
If you’ve been looking for new mount to help you keep an eye on your smart device as you’re riding around town, some highway, or in the middle of nowhere, this is the time to explore the market offerings.
